The decisive mistake was at step 1, when Verification_Expert presented census figures (685,000 men and 755,000 women with tertiary education) as if they came from the 2011 Bulgarian census. No lookup was performed, so the numbers were unsourced. The subsequent arithmetic was fine, but it produced 70.0 from invented inputs, while the correct answer is 234.9. The other agents then accepted and terminated on this unsupported result without checking its source.
